title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: The DataFrame $$`lunch_{mat}`$$ contains columns for the person, calories consumed $$1$$ day ago, calories consumed $$2$$ days ago, and calories consumed today. These columns are used to predict today's calorie intake using a linear model.

title: Linear Regression Coefficients
text: In linear regression, the $$`coef_{}`$$ attribute of the model contains the coefficients for the features. These coefficients correspond to the features in the order they appear in the input data.

title: Indexing the Coefficients
text: Which index of `model.coef_` corresponds to the coefficient for $$`calories_1 d_{ago}`$$?
